response.sql: WITH scan_rates AS (SELECT crewref, scancount, gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0) AS gb_per_min FROM scans WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL), op_stats AS (SELECT crewref, SUM(scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM scan_rates WHERE gb_per_min IS NOT NULL GROUP BY crewref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS overall_avg FROM op_stats), qualified AS (SELECT o.total_scans, o.avg_gb_per_min FROM op_stats o CROSS JOIN overall v WHERE o.avg_gb_per_min > v.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(q.total_scans) AS avg_total_scans, AVG(q.avg_gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min, AVG(q.avg_gb_per_min - v.overall_avg) AS avg_margin_above_overall FROM qualified q CROSS JOIN overall v;

assumptions.assumption: Rows with NULL gbsize or NULL spanmin are excluded, and a spanmin of 0 is treated as missing (NULLIF avoids division by zero). Scans with a NULL scancount still count toward the GB-per-minute average but add nothing to the operator's total.

Each operator's GB-per-minute figure is the mean of the per-scan ratios gbsize ÷ spanmin, as the request specifies. The all-operator average is the simple mean of those per-operator figures, not a mean over all scan rows.

The single-row 'average total number of scans' is the mean across qualifying operators of each operator's summed scancount. The 'average margin' is the mean across qualifying operators of (operator GB/min minus the all-operator average). No rounding is applied.
